theorems.name: Tetrahedral chirality Bianchi parity
theorems.statement: For six F2 overlap bits on K4, the xor of the four triangular face holonomies is zero because each edge occurs in exactly two faces.

theorems.name: Face-holonomy gauge invariance
theorems.statement: The four triangle holonomies are invariant under vertex-frame flips e_ij -> e_ij+g_i+g_j.

theorems.name: Complete gauge classification
theorems.statement: Two edge transition systems are vertex-gauge equivalent iff their four face holonomy vectors agree; every even face vector is realized.

theorems.name: Eight-class quotient
theorems.statement: C^1(K4;F2)/delta C^0(K4;F2) is identified with the eight-element even-weight code E4, hence has dimension three over F2.

theorems.name: Global signed-J criterion
theorems.statement: One globally signed chiral generator exists across the four slices iff every face holonomy vanishes.

theorems.name: Trivialization uniqueness
theorems.statement: A flat transition system has exactly two trivializing slice frames, exchanged by simultaneous reversal of all four local generators.

theorems.name: S4 orbit trichotomy
theorems.statement: The eight even face vectors form S4 orbits of weights 0, 2 and 4, with orbit sizes 1, 6 and 1.

theorems.name: Unique nonzero fully symmetric class
theorems.statement: The full S4 fixed subspace of the even face code is generated by 1111; the only fixed classes are 0000 and 1111.

theorems.name: Accepted P000 antibalanced identification
theorems.statement: Encoding every accepted negative overlap sign by bit one gives the all-one edge representative, whose four face holonomies are 1111; it is the unique nonzero fully S4-invariant gauge class.

theorems.name: Antibalanced signed-J obstruction
theorems.statement: The all-face-odd transition class admits no untwisted globally signed J.

theorems.name: Exact edge-assignment distribution
theorems.statement: Among all 64 edge assignments, 8 are flat, 48 have face weight two, and 8 are all-face-odd; every gauge orbit has size eight.

theorems.name: Typed separation from twelve-direction sign closure
theorems.statement: A globally coherent sign assignment on the twelve oriented FCC nearest-neighbor directions does not imply flat transport of three-axis slice cyclic orders or local complex structures.

theorems.name: Antibalanced orientation cover is the cube
theorems.statement: The eight signed slice states in the all-face-odd class are canonically isomorphic as a graph to the three-dimensional cube Q3; the four slices are its four antipodal body diagonals.

theorems.name: Chirality deck transformation is cube antipodality
theorems.statement: The global sheet flip J -> -J acts under the cube labeling as x -> x xor 111 and is fixed-point free.

theorems.name: Orientation-cover connectedness classification
theorems.statement: The signed orientation cover is connected iff the face-holonomy class is non-flat; flat systems give two tetrahedra of size four, whereas all non-flat systems give one eight-state connected cover.

theorems.name: Symmetry-plus-connectedness selection theorem
theorems.statement: Among fully S4-symmetric chirality transition systems, connected signed transport is equivalent to the antibalanced gauge class and therefore selects face holonomy 1111.
